description: Is Stand's name heard? Six ways of speaking to it by name, from two voices. Each should get an answer. Run with STAND_CONTEXT=poc/heckler/context.

discussion.say: Right, I think that covers the venue.
Stand, do you know how many people came on Tuesday?
Stand, what room did the pilot run in?
Hey Stand, when is the next rehearsal?
Where does your name come from, Stand?
I have a question for Stand. Can you join a Zoom call today?
Stand. Are you still with us?
Good. I think we are done then.
